rows.label: LOOK 07
rows.text: Workwear jumpsuit, a mid to dark body and pale pockets

notes: The last three looks. LOOK 05 is a pieced shirt with raw edges left showing at the yoke and cuffs. LOOK 06 uses the dark marks left by unpicked pockets as a pattern across the front of a dress, the same trace as the first image on the moodboard. LOOK 07 is a workwear jumpsuit with a dark and mid body and pale pockets, and it closes the collection.
